lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: go-bluemonday-unrestricted-or-unshared-data-uri-policy
title: 'bluemonday policy allows unrestricted data: URIs or uses a private data-URI validator'
summary: Allowing the "data" scheme in a bluemonday policy with AllowURLSchemes permits every data URI,
  including data:text/html and data:image/svg+xml, which leads to XSS. The safe form registers "data"
  through AllowURLSchemeWithCustomPolicy with a shared validator (IsSafeDataURI) that only accepts raster
  image MIME types. A package-private copy of that validator is not reusable by other policies, such as
  the ipynb sanitizer, which then fall back to the unrestricted scheme.

rule:
  message: 'The bluemonday policy handles the "data" URL scheme unsafely, or the safe-data-URI validator
    is package-private and so cannot be shared by other sanitizer policies. Allowing "data" without a
    MIME restriction permits data:text/html payloads and XSS. Use AllowURLSchemeWithCustomPolicy("data",
    markup.IsSafeDataURI), where IsSafeDataURI is exported.

    '
  pattern-either:
  - pattern: $P.AllowURLSchemes(..., "data", ...)
  - pattern: $P.AllowURLSchemeWithCustomPolicy("data", isSafeDataURI)
  - pattern: "func isSafeDataURI(...) bool {\n  ...\n}\n"
fix:
  guidance: Never allow the "data" scheme wholesale in a bluemonday policy. Export the validator as markup.IsSafeDataURI,
    which accepts only png, jpeg, gif, webp and x-icon, and register it with AllowURLSchemeWithCustomPolicy
    in every sanitizer policy, including the ipynb sanitizer.
  example: 'p := bluemonday.UGCPolicy()

    // Only allow data URIs with safe image MIME types

    p.AllowURLSchemeWithCustomPolicy("data", markup.IsSafeDataURI)

    '
